title: Planned Wrightsville Beach skywatch broadcast through the World Forum

tellings.quote: We're going to have a group down on the beach at Rightsville. [gasps] Um about 40 of us doing a skywatch and we're going to broadcast it through the world forum.

plain: Chris Bledsoe, a man who says UFOs appear around him and that NASA has studied him, describes a plan for 2025. He says about 40 people would gather on the beach at Wrightsville Beach, North Carolina, to watch the sky together, and that the event would be broadcast through a group he calls the World Forum. He tells it because he believes the lights will show up when he calls, in front of witnesses.
